author: Chao-Jen Huang (ephoton)
title: IC Package Definition Schema
description: Defines the physical package geometry, ball/pad layout, and pin assignments for Bravotek IC products. Supports WLCSP, QFN, DFN, BGA, and other package types.

$schema.description: Reference to the package schema file.

device.description: Device part number this package is associated with (e.g. BV6820).

description.description: Human-readable description of this package configuration.

geometry.description: Physical dimensions of the package body.

unit.description: Unit for all dimension values in this package definition.

x.description: Package body dimension along the X axis (horizontal, longer edge for landscape orientation).

y.description: Package body dimension along the Y axis (vertical).

z.description: Package body height / thickness (optional, for 3D reference).

pin_array.description: Ball or pad grid geometry. All spatial values use the unit defined in geometry.unit.

pitch_x.description: Center-to-center spacing between adjacent balls/pads in the X direction.

pitch_y.description: Center-to-center spacing between adjacent balls/pads in the Y direction.

diameter.description: Ball or pad diameter (circular) or equivalent size.

margin_x.description: Distance from the package body edge to the center of the nearest ball/pad in the X direction.

margin_y.description: Distance from the package body edge to the center of the nearest ball/pad in the Y direction.

alternating_type.description: Pin alternating pattern for non-uniform grids. 0 = standard rectangular grid. 1-4 = special staggered layouts defined in the Bravotek Visio add-in.

top_view.description: If true, the pin layout is drawn as seen from the top (die side up). Column order is mirrored on the X axis. Default false = bottom view (PCB mounting side).

pins.description: Ordered pin definitions. Order is row-major: row A (or row 0) first, left-to-right within each row. Length must equal columns × rows.

display.description: SVG rendering and label display preferences.

show_designator_inside.description: Show the ball designator (e.g. A1) inside the ball circle.

show_designator_outside.description: Show the ball designator outside the ball circle.

show_pin_name.description: Show the pin signal name next to the ball.

pin_font_size.description: Base font size for pin name labels (in SVG user units, scaled proportionally).

name.description: Signal name for this pin (e.g. VIN, AGND, LX).

description.description: Optional description of the pin function.
